arStrings.szText: You gain {if:SF_26}{c_number}{SF_18}{/c} Vigor per second while you have {c_important}Withering Fist's{/c} {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c}.{else}{c_number}{SF_16}{/c} Vigor per second for every Nearby enemy Poisoned by {c_important}Withering Fist{/c}, up to {c_number}{SF_17}{/c}.{/if}
{c_important}Withering Fist{/c} Heals you for {c_number}[{SF_41}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_41]){/c}.
{c_important}Withering Fist's{/c} Poisoning duration is increased by {c_number}{SF_44}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Withering Fist's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack spreads its Poisoning to {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} Nearby enemies and Slows them for {c_number}[{SF_37}*100|%|]{/c} more.

{c_important}Withering Fist's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack's burst is {c_number}[(1-{SF_35})*100|%|]{/c} smaller, but deals {c_number}[{SF_36}*100|%|]{/c} increased Poisoning damage and applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Withering Fist{/c} becomes a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill that deals Physical damage. 

{c_important}Withering Fist's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack releases a shockwave that deals {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_THIRD_C}{/c} damage. It grants {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} equal to {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Health {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_30]){/c} for {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} seconds per enemy hit, up to {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c} {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_32]){/c}.
